proposal.reason: Main change is in network transport/plugin/proxy: NET/CollNet selection moves to per-communicator state, proxy posted-op batching/shutdown behavior changes, and NET resource/memory handling is refactored around communicator-owned backends. Communicator lifecycle also changes substantively (netName config/env override ownership, plugin retain/finalize pairing, parent-child shared-resource backend compatibility, and teardown guards). Device-topology and graph-search need review because topology/path construction and graph comparison now depend on the communicator-selected NET/EIC backend (including PXN disable and EIC-sensitive path decisions), not just global state.
